(i) electronic equipment or technology;
(ii) any data held within, or accessible from, any electronic

police officer searching and seizing any such equipment or

mappings.impact: The provision requires a person subject to a control order to facilitate access to electronic equipment or technology and any data held within or accessible from such equipment for police officers conducting searches or seizures.

The provision requires a person subject to a control order to comply with conditions imposed by a specified authority, including restrictions on the use of specified forms of telecommunication or other technology, such as the internet, and may require facilitation of access to electronic equipment or data held within or accessible from such equipment.
